scope: Fixed relation markers and flexible context; no semantic claim
checks: Finite maximum-draft SVG probe: 80 fields, 160 ordinary IDs and 800 context pairs complete initial rendering and full rerouting within five seconds each
Real square click/hover, all/selected/hidden and two-square creation retain IDs and existing directed pair without duplicates
Explicit branched mini-graph: three directed contextual links are dashed SVG paths between ordinary IDs; all curves outside every node rectangle; exact fixed edge marker endpoints
Dragging a node not incident to either ordinary edge reroutes existing context around its new rectangle without changing IDs
Actual line click, right-click, Shift+F10 and Enter open context form; reversal updates direction, deletion removes only selected pair, explicit addition restores a pair
Permanent graph shows same context IDs; inspection returns to originating draft; neighbourhood omits links with invisible endpoint edges and reports them
Fit, zoom and three viewport sizes retain obstacle-free flexible links without adding a second page
Covered attachment points report unrouted pairs explicitly; all IDs remain accessible in the object list and reappear when the obstructing field moves away
Process restart, GUI export/import and archived full history retain exact IDs, context direction, drafts and routes; routing geometry is derived, absent from stored format
